title: L2 Desktop Support Engineer (Field)
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a skilled and customer\-focused **L2 Desktop Support Engineer (Field)** to provide on\-site technical support, troubleshooting, and maintenance for desktops, laptops, printers, and peripheral devices. The role requires traveling to client/user locations to resolve escalated issues from L1 support, ensure minimal downtime, and deliver excellent end\-user experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide **on\-site technical support** for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT peripherals.
* Handle **escalated L2 issues** from the Service Desk / L1 support.
* Perform **software installation, configuration, and upgrades** (Windows, MS Office, Antivirus, etc.).
* Troubleshoot **hardware/network issues** including LAN, Wi\-Fi connectivity, and VPN.
* Maintain and update **asset inventory** of IT equipment at client/user sites.
* Coordinate with L3/Server/Network teams for unresolved issues.
* Ensure **adherence to SLA timelines** and documentation of all activities in the ticketing system.
* Support users in **Microsoft 365, email configuration, and basic Active Directory tasks** (password reset, user creation, etc.).
* Perform preventive maintenance, health checks, and support IT rollouts or deployments.
* Provide end\-user training and guidance for IT policies and tools.

**Key Skills \& Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of **Windows OS, MS Office, Outlook, O365**.
* Hands\-on experience in **desktop/laptop hardware troubleshooting**.
* Knowledge of **Active Directory, DHCP, DNS, and basic networking**.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and travel for field support.
* Strong problem\-solving and customer service mindset.

**Qualification \& Experience:**

* Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* 1–7 years of experience in **Desktop Support / IT Field Support** (minimum 1\+ year in L2 support).

**Perks \& Benefits:**

* Travel allowance for field visits.
* On\-the\-job training \& certification support.
* Career growth opportunities into L3/Systems/Network roles.

title: Material Data Management System Administrator
description:
**Position Overview**


Ascend Performance Materials is seeking a Material Data Management System Administrator to support the configuration, data expansion, and ongoing improvement of our web\-based material data management system.


This role requires a blend of technical data handling skills and a strong background in understanding material properties, technical datasheets, testing standards, and engineering documentation. You will focus on preparing the system to receive structured material, product, and technical data using tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, and platform\-native upload features.

**Targeted Outcomes**

* Support the successful expansion and ongoing maintenance of Ascend's web\-based material data management system.
* Develop repeatable processes for preparing, formatting, validating, and uploading material and product data into the system.
* Enable efficient mass uploads of technical data from Excel, Word, PDF, and legacy source files.
* Support technical engineers and business users by improving workflows, reporting, and access to accurate material data

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Configuration \& Administration:**

* Configure and maintain the web\-based material data management platform, including user workflows, templates, forms, user roles, and system settings.
* Format and structure system fields to store material, product, and technical data in a consistent and searchable format.
* Configure low\-code/no\-code features including forms, approval routing, data views, and reporting tools.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, coordinate with engineering or software vendors, and track issues through resolution

**Data Formatting, Migration \& Mass Uploads:**

* Utilize SQL, Python, Excel, and platform\-native tools for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading.
* Extract unstructured or semi\-structured data from Word, PDF, and Excel documents into database\-ready formats.
* Perform mass uploads of product data, technical datasheets, property tables, document links, and related literature.
* Audit legacy systems to resolve missing, duplicated, inconsistent, or improperly formatted entries.

**Material Data \& Cross\-Functional Support:**

* Work closely with technical engineering and product teams to translate data requirements into structured fields and reports.
* Maintain revision control, data traceability, and controlled\-document practices across product data.
* Build reporting dashboards and analytics using Excel, Power BI, SQL, or native platform reporting tools.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Management, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Data Management:** Proven experience working with structured data formatting, data transformation, migration, and mass upload processes.
* **Document Extraction:** Demonstrated experience extracting and preparing data from Excel, Word, PDF, and technical documents.
* **Technical Skills:** Working knowledge of **SQL**, **Python**, Excel, Power BI, and database concepts.
* **System Support:** Experience supporting web\-based enterprise applications, technical data systems, or document management platforms, including low\-code/no\-code configurations.
* **Vendor \& User Support:** Background working with software vendors or technical support teams to resolve application bugs and system issues.
* **Domain Exposure (Preferred):** Familiarity with material properties, product datasheets, testing standards, or engineering documentation is a strong plus

**About Us:**

  

Ascend Performance Materials is the premium provider of high\-quality chemicals, fibers and plastics focused on improving quality of life and inspiring a better tomorrow through innovation. We are a fully integrated material solutions provider with manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe and Asia.

  

Our global workforce makes the materials used to make safer vehicles, cleaner energy, better medical devices, smarter appliances, and longer\-lasting apparel and consumer goods. We are committed to safety, sustainability, and the success of our customers and our communities.

Through clear expectations, empowered decision\-making, intentional communication, and continuous feedback, we create a culture built on action, visibility, and shared success.

  

Together, OARS gives us a shared language and clear direction. These values guide our decisions, shape priorities and set expectations as we move forward – aligned, focused and committed to creating performance materials that improve lives today and inspire a better tomorrow.

title: Principal IT Pillar Specialist - ISM (Information system Manager)
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Principal IT Pillar Specialist is responsible for interpreting internal or external business issues and recommending best practices. They will be tasked with solving complex IT Pillar\-related problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. They may be responsible for leading functional teams or projects and are regarded as a specialist in the field of IT Pillar. As such, they must have in\-depth expertise in the IT Pillar as well as broad knowledge of the IT Pillar discipline within the Information Technology function.


  
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
  

  

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.
  
**Key Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Responsible for entire life cycle information management process of projects, from initial estimate to final completions and handover.
* Review of Invitation to Bid (ITT) from Clients for the Information Management requirements and assessment of the risks \& opportunities in this area
* Co\-ordinate with Business and IT stakeholders in the preparation of the Information \& Systems Management Execution Plan for proposals and projects
* Prepare Information \& Systems Management estimates covering hardware, resources and licenses and control spending within the allocated budgets
* Prepare and review of proposal write\-ups
* Coordinate the project specific infrastructure setup for construction sites, client resident teams and joint venture partners in cooperation with Engineering IT and Project IT.
* Specify and coordinate the processes and tools for data collection, validation consolidation and handover to the Client.
* Single point of contact to project management and to the Client for all aspects related to Information Management and supporting systems.
* Translate project specific information requirements into efficient system configurations and related user instructions in conjunction with execution tool administrators.
* Prepare functional specification and manage the development and implementation of project specific applications and/or interfaces
* Detect and manage project scope changes
* Capture lessons learned, best practices and ensure their embedding in the organization.
* Initiate and conducting Information Systems Management (ISM) audits and peer reviews
Provide input to audits and peer reviews, undertake other project audits as required.  
* 

**Required Key Project Execution Knowledge and/or Concepts Requirements:**

* Planning \& Progress Measurement
* Concepts of Project Budget and Cost Control
* Engineering
  

	+ Design Software Tools
	+ Data Management Standards
	+ CHIFOS (JIP 36\)
	+ ISO 15926
	+ ISO 14224
	+ PODS
	+ Analysis and Calculation Tools
	+ Pipeline and GIS Tools
	+ Vendor / Supplier Data / Documentation
	+ Deliverables
* Document Management Systems and Concepts
* SCM
  

	+ Engineering – MTO / MR – SCM Interface
	+ Technical Bid Evaluation Process
	+ PO Process
	+ Expediting Process including TPI Inspection and Material Test Certificates
	+ Logistics Process
	+ Warehousing and Material Preservation Process
* Fabrication / Construction
  

	+ Spooling Process and Tools
	+ Steel Structures Fabrication Drawing Generation
	+ Advanced Work Packaging Process and Tools
	+ Fabrication / Construction Work Measurement Tools
	+ Concepts of Flange Management
	+ Hot Tapping
	+ Pigging
* Quality Control
  

	+ Material Test Certificates
	+ Third Party Inspections at Manufacturer’s Location
	+ Welding Non\-Destructive Testing
	+ Hydrotesting
* Commissioning
  

	+ System Sub\-System Definitions
	+ Status Index
	+ Inspection Test Reports (ITR)
	+ Punch Management
	+ Project Technical Assurance
	+ Completions Certification
* Client Handover Packaging
  

	+ Data
	+ Documentation

  
**Essential Qualifications and Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Minimum 8\+ years of experience in IT supporting EPCI business applications as a lead or administrator.
* Extensive functional knowledge in the Payroll industry and leadership expertise.
* Extensive Project Management experience.
* Ability to work as a team member as well as act as a team leader.
* Have wide experience with technical tools such as ERP, BI, etc.
* Maintain key competencies associated with the IT function.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
* Must be a finance IT SME in process \& technical knowledge of Timekeeping systems, General Accounting, Job Cost Accounting, Sub\-ledgers, General Ledger, and Close Cycles (month, quarter year).
